Speaking at @physicswallah IOI definitely wasn’t something I expected in 2026, but I’m incredibly grateful for the opportunity. ✨

Had an amazing time delivering a session on Building AI Agents & Observability, where we built AI agents from scratch, explored LangGraph (Graphs & State), Tool Calling, Agent Workflows, and learned how to trace and debug agents using LangSmith.

Always grateful for opportunities to share what I’m learning with such an enthusiastic audience. Here’s to more building, more learning, and many more stages ahead. 

[AI Agents | Agentic AI | LangGraph | LangSmith | AI Observability | LLMs | Generative AI | AI Engineering | AI Engineer | Agent Workflows , Tech ]

#physicswallah #pw #aiagents #tech

No wayy I got invited to @paytm office to speak on AI Agents 👀💙

It was amazing interacting with such an engaged audience and discussing how AI agents are evolving from demos to production systems through tracing, evaluation, and observability.

Grateful for the opportunity, the conversations, and everyone who joined the session. Looking forward to many more!

#aiagent #events #tech #paytm #coding

Got to interact with teams building across AI, ML, Web3 and more.

Grateful for the experience ✨

posts.text: A lot of you have been asking me, “How were your AI/ML interviews?” So I thought, why not drop a couple of questions that might actually be useful for you : 1. Your ML model is performing well, but GPU utilization is only 30%. How would you approach optimizing it? Small hint: Don’t immediately blame the GPU. First identify where the bottleneck is. Look at data loading, CPU → GPU transfers, batch size, memory utilization, and the inference/training pipeline. 2.
